high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up of an old, tattered piece of parchment with a handwritten note on it. The parchment is held up against a blurred background that appears to be a dimly lit room or space, possibly a library or study, given the presence of shelves filled with books and other items. The lighting is low, creating a somber and mysterious atmosphere. The text on the parchment reads: "The transformation overtakes the afflicted seemingly at random. Some are lucid for weeks, and speak pleasantly with their Conservators before they simply... change.
